item.title: USS Abraham Lincoln sails past Singapore on its way home from Middle East
item.description: The U.S. aircraft carrier USS Abraham Lincoln has sailed past Singapore as it heads home

item.title: Pakistan will award nurse for saving sole newborn survivor of hospital nursery fire
item.description: A Pakistani nurse who rescued the sole surviving newborn from a hospital fire that killed 14 other infants will receive one of the country’s top civil awards

item.title: Death toll rises to 38 from Russia's deadliest attack on Ukraine this year
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said the death toll from a Russian strike on a warehouse west of Kyiv has risen to 38, with four people still missing

item.title: Nepal warns of more possible floods as communities grapple with devastation
item.description: Authorities in Nepal are warning of potential fresh flooding as water levels rise in the Bhotekoshi River
